¿Cómo se lee el I Ching?: How is the I Ching read?
El I Ching, o Libro de los Cambios, es u: The I Ching, or Book of Changes, is a Chinese text about three thousand years old. It describes 64 situations in life; each is drawn with six lines and is called a hexagram.
<b>las líneas</b>Entera es yang: lo acti: the linesSolid is yang: the active, what moves forward. Broken is yin: the receptive, what receives. They are read from the bottom up: the first is the beginning, the sixth the end.
<b>los trigramas</b>Las tres líneas de a: the trigramsThe three lower lines and the three upper ones form two trigrams, eight images of nature: heaven ☰, earth ☷, thunder ☳, water ☵, mountain ☶, wind ☴, fire ☲ and lake ☱. Below is the inner or what begins; above, the outer or what arrives.
<b>en pocas palabras</b>Un resumen en le: in a few wordsA plain-language summary, written for Endeles, of what the hexagram suggests.
<b>juicio e imagen</b>El juicio es la se: judgment and imageThe judgment is the ancient verdict on the situation. The image translates it into a scene of nature and an attitude of the “noble person”, that is, someone who acts with integrity.
<b>las líneas que cambian</b>En una tira: changing linesIn a throw, some lines come out “old” (○ and ×) and turn into their opposite. They point to what is moving and lead to a second hexagram: where the situation is heading.
<b>el hexagrama nuclear</b>Las líneas 2: the nuclear hexagramLines 2 to 5 hide another hexagram inside the first: what the situation keeps within.
<b>el calendario</b>Endeles reparte los: the calendarEndeles spreads the 64 hexagrams around the circle of the sky, about 5.6° each, in the order of the wheel used by Human Design. So the Sun, the Earth and the Moon are always in a hexagram, and so was the Sun on the day you were born.
No es una predicción. Lee la pregunta y: It isn’t a prediction. Read the question and let the image speak about your situation: what resonates is yours; what doesn’t, let it pass.
Endeles es un bosque sin hojas hecho de: Endeles is a leafless forest made of ink, fog and grain. You walk through it and listen: each sound space has a radius where it sounds complete and a reach where it fades. The weather is modulated like a score of states, or taken from the real sky of a place.
